caption_zh: 全部自然评价窗中的导航轨迹，按真实评价点分列。左列在POI中点显示本文、单/双位置IEKF文献与标定参数，以及单次初始化OiSAM的全部有效轨迹；右列在GNSS1天线点显示按记录缺口重新初始化的OiSAM、TC-FGO和GNC-FGO。参考线使用同一评价点；缺测和重新初始化块边界断线。OiSAM圆圈为首个动态输出，叉号为最后动态输出，左列文字保留输出分母。小窗围绕固定参考事件位置显示真实局部坐标差，没有拟合旋转/平移或人为放大误差。所有原生有效点均保留；零动态输出的方法不虚构轨迹。GINav原生IMU部分输出和相对里程计另页展示。 米尺度轨迹高度重合是实际结果，精度差应结合左列局部和误差配图读取，不将不同方法人为错位。
caption_en: Navigation trajectories across the complete natural evaluation windows, separated by physical point. Left: LegSA-GINS, the literature/calibrated single- and dual-position IEKFs, and single-initialization OiSAM at the POI midpoint. Right: recorded-gap-reinitialized OiSAM, TC-FGO and GNC-FGO at GNSS1. Each reference uses the same point. Curves break across output gaps and initialization-block boundaries. Circles and crosses identify OiSAM first and last dynamic outputs; the left panels retain output counts over the full nominal windows. Insets show true spatial differences around fixed reference-defined event locations, without fitted rotations, translations or error magnification. All finite native outputs are retained; no trajectory is invented for zero dynamic support. Native GINav partial outputs and relative-only estimators are shown separately. Metre-scale overlap is expected; inspect the POI insets and companion errors for precision differences. No method-dependent offsets are applied.
